summary: The agentsaccept suite under agents_scenario.c, each independent workload on a private GNU disk and restricted network

cases.behavior: agentsaccept: agy, with a private GNU root, SSH port and fake API server

execution.privileges: the ordinary test account in the guest; root installs private fixtures
execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends its machines and API services; workload actions reap host children and retain private evidence only after a failure

steps.does: make the private CA and API scripts
boot the private GNU disk until init starts sshd
log in over SSH and stage the workload files
run the interactive session against its API script
ask the guest to reboot and observe the QEMU reset event
boot the same private disk again
compare the persisted credential digests
run the agent authenticated against its script after the reboot
run gh authenticated against its script after the reboot
check the log for credentials and remove the guest workspace

services.does: play the private script over TLS on the case port, recording each request and printing a final verdict on SIGTERM

assertions.checks: the private CA and scripts are prepared
the private GNU root mounts and init starts sshd
the selected agent and gh have their pinned versions, executable paths, credential files and a filter that redacts their strings

the agent starts its packaged executable, commits the requested change with a clean tree, cancels a running command, follows a resized terminal, survives a lost SSH client and reopens its conversation
the session script played every required request and rejected none
QEMU reports a reset after the guest calls reboot
a new QEMU boot mounts the same private GNU disk and starts sshd
the credential files have the same digests after the reboot
the agent has the same executable and version and answers a signed-in request after the reboot
the authenticated request played the whole script without an unexpected request
gh has the same executable and version and authenticates after the reboot
gh played its authenticated API script
none of the selected credentials occurs in the transcript and the guest workspace is removed

native.reason: the test needs a fresh GNU root and the restricted QEMU user network whose only outbound route reaches this case API service
